ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(City__c, "New York"), NOT(ISBLANK(Concert_Date__c)), OR(MONTH(Concert_Date__c) = 12, MONTH(Concert_Date__c) = 1, MONTH(Concert_Date__c) = 2))
